PM Modi Declares India 'Mother of Democracy' Amidst Police Actions

Prime Minister Narendra Modi stated that India is the 'mother of democracy' where 'people openly debate', during a global address. This statement comes after days of what The Wire described as 'unprecedented police action on citizens'. The Wire and The Telegraph (India) reported on Modi's remarks.
